macro_context.market_sentiment: Mixed-to-cautiously-positive as of May 5: S&P 500 +0.9% and Nasdaq hit a new intraday ATH on ceasefire relief, but Monday May 4 saw Dow -1.13% on Middle East missile intercept news. Oil remains elevated, keeping inflation fears alive and cyclicals under pressure.
macro_context.fed_outlook: FOMC held rates at 3.50–3.75% on April 29 (8-4 split, most divided since October 1992). Powell's final meeting as Chair. Markets pricing zero cuts in 2026 and one 25bp cut in December 2027. Elevated inflation partly attributed to global energy prices.
macro_context.geopolitical: Fragile U.S.-Iran ceasefire with fresh Strait of Hormuz incidents; UAE intercepted Iranian missiles May 4. U.S. intervention in Venezuela ongoing. NATO tensions around Greenland. Combined tariff uncertainty + Fed leadership transition + midterm elections elevate risk premium. Oil price spike pressuring cyclicals and stoking inflation.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Consensus is Hold across 16–37 analyst coverage sources. Average 12-month price target ranges $901–$915 depending on source (WallStreetZen: $904.27; MarketScreener: $915.15; 16-analyst avg: $901.19). Seeking Alpha downgraded to Hold on March 7, 2026 citing technical weakness and market uncertainty. Distribution (37 analysts): 8 Buy, 17 Hold, 1 Sell. High target $1,050, low target $600. Stock trading ~$904, implying roughly flat consensus.

web_context.competitor_activity: JPMorgan posted FICC revenue of $7.1B (+21% YoY) in Q1 2026, and Morgan Stanley saw FICC +29%, both far outpacing GS's 10% FICC decline — a notable competitive disadvantage in fixed income. However, GS led all banks in M&A advisory by deal value in Q1 2026. M&A revenues were broadly strong across the bulge bracket on the back of a $1.2T global M&A quarter (+42% YoY). Morgan Stanley is GS's closest comparable on IB revenue mix, both more IB-dependent than JPMorgan.
web_context.earnings_info: Q1 2026 reported April 13, 2026: net revenues $17.23B, EPS $17.55 (beat estimate $16.37 by 7.2%), ROCE 19.8%. Next earnings (Q2 2026) expected ~July 14–22, 2026 (before market open). Q2 2026 consensus EPS estimate ~$13.72, revenue estimate ~$15.68B (seasonal step-down from Q1).
